subject: Biotechnology
title: Bioprinting Tissues
description: A quick win: understand Bioprinting Tissues.

hook.text: Print a kidney layer by layer — 3D bioprinting deposits living cells in precise patterns to build functional tissues.

buildup.text: Bioinks combine cells with hydrogels — the gel supports cell growth while the printer builds the tissue's architecture.

discovery.text: Organovo bioprinted liver tissue that metabolizes drugs — pharmaceutical companies use it for toxicity testing.

twist.text: Printing simple tissues works — but building thick, vascularized organs with billions of precisely placed cells remains unsolved.

climax.text: Sacrificial ink printing creates channels that become blood vessels — a breakthrough for vascularizing thick bioprinted tissues.

punchline.text: Print cells like ink on paper — bioprinting builds living tissues from digital blueprints.

quiz.question: What is the biggest challenge in bioprinting transplantable organs?
options: Bioprinters are too slow to print cells before they die
Creating thick, vascularized organs with billions of precisely placed cells and functional blood vessel networks
No biocompatible inks exist for human cells
